subject: Film & Cinema
title: Mumblecore: DIY American Indies
description: Learn Mumblecore: DIY American Indies in one minute.

hook.text: In the 2000s, filmmakers with consumer cameras made films about awkward conversations.

buildup.text: Mumblecore featured improvised dialogue, no-name actors, and budgets under $50,000.

discovery.text: Films like The Puffy Chair captured millennial anxiety with uncomfortable authenticity.

twist.text: The Duplass brothers and Greta Gerwig graduated from mumblecore to mainstream careers.

climax.text: Mumblecore showed that digital technology democratized filmmaking for a new generation.

punchline.text: The cheapest films launched the biggest careers.

quiz.question: What characterized mumblecore films?
options: Improvised dialogue, low budgets, and digital cameras
